Surat runs on two engines: the heavy industry out at Hazira — ONGC, Reliance, L&T, ArcelorMittal and the LNG terminals — and the vast textile and diamond economy packed into the GIDC estates at Sachin, Pandesara and Katargam. Both keep large project and production sites that need solid, lockable site offices. SAMAN is a container office manufacturer, not a marketplace reseller; we build steel units and dispatch them into Surat from our Greater Noida factory. See the container office category we build to order, and this page covers what Surat buyers ask before they order.

Who buys container offices in Surat

EPC and heavy-engineering contractors at Hazira use them as project offices, permit and safety rooms, and supervisor cabins on large sites. Textile and diamond units in the GIDC belts use them as admin, accounts and QC cabins where a permanent room isn't practical. Logistics and warehousing operators along the highway belts use them as gate and documentation cabins. Builders across Surat's fast-growing industrial and residential projects use them as construction site offices and security posts. The common need is a rugged unit that arrives finished and holds up in a humid, coastal-industrial environment.

Surat industrial zones we deliver to

We dispatch across the city's main industrial belts:

  • Hazira industrial belt (394270) — the heavy-engineering, port and LNG cluster; project offices and safety cabins for EPC and process sites.
  • Sachin GIDC (394230) — a large mixed industrial and SEZ estate; site offices, admin cabins and storage-cum-office units.
  • Pandesara GIDC (394221) — the textile-processing and MSME manufacturing belt; supervisor and accounts cabins.
  • Katargam GIDC (395004) — the diamond and small-manufacturing cluster; compact admin cabins.

Sites outside these pockets — Palsana, Kadodara, Kim or along the Surat–Navsari highway — are also served; share the location when you enquire and we will confirm transport.

Container office sizes and specifications

A SAMAN container office is a fabricated steel structure, not a repainted shipping box. The frame uses mild steel sections to IS 2062, panelled and finished in our factory so the unit lands ready to use. Typical configurations:

SizeFootprint (approx)Typical use in Surat
10 ft10 × 8 ftGate/security cabin, single-desk supervisor post
20 ft20 × 8 ftSite office, admin cabin, QC/documentation room
40 ft40 × 8 ftMulti-desk project office, safety room + store

We can supply the base unit as a 20ft or 40ft shipping container office. Typical build (final specification confirmed at quotation):

  • Frame: MS sections to IS 2062, welded, anchor-bolt ready
  • Walls: PUF / rockwool sandwich panel or cement board, insulated
  • Roof: galvanised / GI profile sheet with slope for drainage
  • Floor: ply base with vinyl or IPS finish
  • Openings: powder-coated door(s) and windows with grills and shutters
  • Electricals: MCB distribution board, internal points, lights and fan provision

Customisation options

Surat orders are usually customised for the site and the use. We can add: partition walls for separate cabins; AC provision and added insulation for admin, textile and diamond-unit use; toilet and pantry blocks; additional windows or a glazed front; extra corrosion protection for the humid Hazira coastal belt; and ramps or external steps. For demanding heavy-industry positions we can build on a heavy-grade cargo container office shell. Tell us the team size, the site conditions and whether the unit moves between sites, and we configure accordingly.

Delivery and installation in Surat

We manufacture near Greater Noida and dispatch to Surat by road, a long haul of roughly 1,100 km via the Delhi–Mumbai Expressway / NH48 corridor that we handle regularly. A default delivery charge of ₹3,000 applies where relevant, with final transport confirmed by site distance and access; given the distance we confirm a realistic transit window at order stage. Smaller units are craned or forklifted into place in one visit; 40 ft units need clear offloading access, so confirm gate width and crane room when you enquire. The same plant serves our Ahmedabad container office page, so the line into Gujarat is well established.

Why buy from SAMAN

SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd has manufactured prefab steel structures since 2009 (incorporated 2019), with 500+ projects delivered. We work to ISO 9001:2015 (E20250218645), ISO 14001:2015 (E20250218646) and ISO 45001:2018 (E20250218647), and are registered with NSIC (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207) and DPIIT (DIPP56005). GST (North): 09ABBCS7101B1ZT. Units carry a 5-year structural frame-and-base warranty plus 1–2 years on finishing, and are engineered for a 20–25 year service life. Because we fabricate in-house, you deal with the manufacturer on specification, price and after-sales — useful on long-distance orders where coordination matters. We supply across West and North India, including container offices we supply in Mumbai and the Pune container office page.

Price factors

We quote to specification rather than posting one sticker price, because the cost of a container office in Surat depends on real variables: size (10/20/40 ft), panel and insulation type, corrosion protection for the coastal belt, partitioning, electricals, toilet/pantry additions, finish, and the long-haul transport to your site. Marketplace listings often show a low "starting" figure that excludes fit-out and delivery. We give an itemised quotation so you can compare like for like. Share your size and fit-out needs for an honest price. (7-day return applies, with return shipping borne by the customer.)

FAQs

How much does a container office cost in Surat?

Price depends on size, insulation, corrosion protection, partitions, electricals and fit-out, plus the long-distance transport. A bare 10 ft gate cabin and a fully fitted 40 ft project office sit far apart on cost. We quote to your exact specification — share your requirement for an itemised price.

How long does delivery take to Surat?

Surat is roughly 1,100 km from our Greater Noida factory, so it is a longer haul. We confirm a realistic transit window at order stage based on your site location and access, and dispatch once the unit is built.

Are the units suitable for Hazira heavy-industry and coastal sites?

Yes. We can build on a reinforced shell with extra corrosion protection and the insulation and fit-out your site needs for Hazira and the humid coastal belt. Tell us the conditions and intended use and we configure accordingly.

Can the container office be moved between sites later?

Yes. Container offices are relocatable. If you expect to shift the unit between project sites, tell us at order stage so we specify lifting points and a shell suited to repeated handling.

Call or Send an Enquiry

Call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937 to discuss your Surat container office, or use Send Enquiry for a specification-based quotation.
